info.title: Bordfeed API
info.description:
Bordfeed fills niche job boards and job newsletters with fresh, filtered jobs. Create a feed with the filters you want, then get its new jobs through the API, an export, a webhook to your site, or an email digest.

**Get started**

1. Create an API key in the dashboard under API Keys.
2. Send it with every request: `Authorization: Bearer bf_live_...`.
3. Create a feed (`POST /feeds`) or use one you made in the dashboard.
4. Get its new jobs with `GET /feeds/{id}/jobs?since=last_poll`, on whatever schedule suits your board or newsletter.

Templates and the health check need no API key, so you can preview jobs before you sign up: `GET /templates/remote-writing/preview`.

Guides for webhooks, email digests and exports are at [bordfeed.com/docs](https://bordfeed.com/docs). Bordfeed is in public beta. Changes to `/api/v1` keep existing requests working, and a breaking change would come with a new API version.

get.description:
Get the jobs that match a feed, newest first. Use `since=last_poll` to get only the jobs that are new since your last request, then publish them to your board or newsletter. Works even when the feed's scheduled delivery is turned off. Results are paginated with `cursor`.

Each full job costs 1 credit, charged once per organization, and getting it again is free, even after it changes or closes. Empty pages are free. New accounts on pay as you go start with a one-time $20 credit. If a response gets lost, retry with the same `Idempotency-Key` header and the same `since` or `cursor` on the same UTC day, and the retry is free; `since=last_poll` moves forward after each successful request. On pay as you go, every response carries your remaining credit balance in `X-Bordfeed-Balance-Jobs`.

Add `?facets=` for counts by field, or `?include=highlights` to mark search matches.

template_id.description: Start from a template's filters. Filter fields you send override the template's values for those fields.

pinned_job_ids.description: Jobs to show first in poll and export results.

excluded_job_ids.description: Jobs to always leave out of poll and export results.

excluded_company_ids.description: Leave out every job from these companies.

annotations.description: Your notes on individual jobs, keyed by job id.

since_field.description: Job timestamp that since=last_poll compares (first_visible, updated or created).

FeedCreateRequest.description: Request body to create a feed.

search.description: Searches job titles plus location and workplace type (for example "writer remote" or "nurse texas"); company name and description are not searched. Spaces mean AND, uppercase OR separates alternatives, quotes match a phrase, and -word excludes a word. Max 1000 characters.

location.description: City, state or region matched against the job's location and work type fields. Words in one place must all match, for example "New York". Commas and the word or separate alternatives, for example "Berlin, New York". A state or country after a city narrows that city ("Austin, TX"), and a state's own country narrows that state ("Texas, US"). Use country_code for countries by code.

category.description: Job categories from Bordfeed's category list, matched as whole words, ignoring case, against occupational_category (for example "Computer & IT", "Media, Communications & Writing", "Art, Fashion & Design").

workplace_type.description: Workplace mode. Values: Remote, Hybrid, On-site. Aliases such as remote, hybrid and onsite are accepted and saved as these values.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (for example "US", "DE") or full country names (for example "United States"). Matches the job's workplace country or a remote role's eligible_countries.

career_level.description: Seniority of the role. Values: Internship, Entry, Junior, Mid, Senior, Lead, Manager, Director, VP, C-Level, Founder. Matches the job's career_level.

salary_min.description: Minimum posted pay, in the job's own salary_unit and salary_currency. Not annualized.

salary_max.description: Maximum posted pay, in the job's own salary_unit and salary_currency. Not annualized.

salary_currency.description: ISO 4217 alpha-3 currency code, for example USD or EUR.

has_salary.description: When true, only jobs that show pay (salary_min or salary_max set). False or omitted applies no salary filter.

remote_region.description: Region where a remote candidate may live. Values: Worldwide, US Only, US/Canada Only, Europe Only, UK Only, EMEA, APAC, LATAM.

languages.description: Languages the candidate must use, as ISO 639-1 codes.

skills.description: Required skills, as a string or an array.

experience_level.description: Same as career_level. Values: Internship, Entry, Junior, Mid, Senior, Lead, Manager, Director, VP, C-Level, Founder.

visa_sponsorship.description: Visa sponsorship the listing states. Values: Yes, No.

job_type.description: Employment type. Values: Full-time, Part-time, Contract, Freelance, Internship, Temporary, Apprenticeship.

published_since.description: Only jobs published after this date (ISO 8601).

published_before.description: Only jobs published before this date (ISO 8601).

occupational_category.description: One category from Bordfeed's category list (for example "Computer & IT"), matched exactly against occupational_category. Use category for whole-word matching.

company_size.description: Company size range. Only matches jobs linked to a company profile.

company_funding_stage.description: Company funding stage, for example ["Series A", "Series B"]. Only matches jobs linked to a company profile.

company_tech_stack.description: Company tech stack, for example ["react", "typescript"]. Only matches jobs linked to a company profile.

company_id.description: Only jobs from this company id.

salary_unit.description: Period the posted pay covers. Values: year, month, week, day, hour, project.

source_name.description: Where Bordfeed found the job, for example "lever", "greenhouse" or "workable". Matches job_source_name.

exclude_domains.description: Leave out jobs from companies with these domains, for example ["example.com", "staffing.io"].

benefit_tags.description: Benefit tags, for example health_insurance or equity. Matches jobs that offer any of them.

tools.description: Software and platforms used in the role, as free text. Matches jobs that list any of them.

certifications.description: Required or preferred certifications, as free text. Matches jobs that list any of them.

education_level.description: Minimum required education level (none, high_school, associate, bachelor, master, doctorate, professional).

role_family.description: Role families, for example software_engineering or product_management.

management_scope.description: Management scope (individual_contributor, team_lead, manager, director, executive).

schedule.description: Work schedule the listing states (standard, shift, flexible, weekend, night, on_call).

security_clearance.description: Security clearance the listing names (none, confidential, secret, top_secret, other); none means the listing says no clearance is required.

hiring_urgency.description: Hiring urgency the listing states (immediate, evergreen). A listing that states neither has no value and matches no hiring_urgency filter.

language.description: Language the listing is written in, as ISO 639-1 codes (for example en, de). Not the languages the candidate needs.

experience_years_min.description: Minimum years of experience the job requires. Compared with experience_years_min.

experience_years_max.description: Maximum years of experience the job requires. Compared with experience_years_max.

equity_offered.description: true: only jobs whose listing states equity. false: jobs whose listing does not state equity (Bordfeed stores true or null, so false matches both null and a false the source states).

relocation_assistance.description: true: only jobs whose listing states relocation assistance. false: jobs whose listing does not state it (Bordfeed stores true or null, so false matches both null and a false the source states).

exclude_duplicates.description: When true, keep only the earliest of the jobs that share a canonical_job_id, that is, duplicate posts of one opening.

max_jobs_per_company.description: Newsletter only: the most jobs one employer can have in a newsletter issue, keeping its newest. Without it, a newsletter carries up to 3 per employer. Feed polling, exports and webhooks always return every matching job. Applied after exclude_duplicates.

exclude_agencies.description: When true, leave out jobs from recruiting agencies and staffing companies.

FeedFilters.description: Filters that decide which jobs a feed matches. All fields are optional; unknown fields are rejected.

mode.description: How you receive jobs: poll the API, or get webhook deliveries.

url.description: URL that receives webhook deliveries. Required for webhook mode.

secret.description: Secret used to sign webhook deliveries, at least 16 characters. Required for webhook mode.

frequency.description: How often webhook deliveries are sent. Required for webhook mode.

events.description: Webhook events to subscribe to. Only ["feed.delivery"] is supported.

DeliveryConfig.description: How the feed delivers jobs. `poll` mode needs no other fields; `webhook` mode requires url, secret and frequency.

FeedUpdateRequest.description: Request body to update a feed. All fields are optional; only the fields you send change.

JobFeedbackCreate.description: Report a problem with a job, such as a closed listing, a broken apply link, a duplicate or a low-quality post.

type.description: Employment type as the source or the listing states it. Bordfeed sets a value only when a phrase in the listing supports it. Null when unstated.

canonical_job_id.description: Duplicate group id: jobs that share it are the same opening, and feeds with `exclude_duplicates` keep only the earliest. Reposts of one opening with the same location labels carry the id of the oldest post, when they are on the same board with the same text or on another board of the same source with the same title. Any other job carries a hash of its description, company and title, so identical copies share it.

salary_min.description: Lower end of the posted pay, in salary_unit and salary_currency, with cents when the listing gives them. Not annualized.

salary_max.description: Upper end of the posted pay, in salary_unit and salary_currency, with cents when the listing gives them. Not annualized.

salary_currency.description: ISO 4217 alpha-3 code of the posted pay. The annual USD fields are null when the currency is missing or Bordfeed has no reference exchange rate for it.

salary_unit.description: Period the posted pay covers. The annual USD fields are filled only for year pay; hour, day, week, month and project leave them null.

salary_min_usd.description: salary_min converted to USD at a fixed reference exchange rate. Null when salary_unit is not year.

salary_max_usd.description: salary_max converted to USD at a fixed reference exchange rate. Null when salary_unit is not year.

remote_region.description: Region where a remote candidate may live. Set only on Remote roles: from a region the listing states, or from eligible_countries ([US] is US Only, [GB] UK Only, [US, CA] US/Canada Only; two or more countries all in LATAM, APAC or Europe give that region, and a Europe, Middle East and Africa list gives EMEA). Worldwide means anywhere; a list of named countries is never Worldwide. Null when the listing states no region.

eligible_countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries where a remote candidate may live: a country list the listing states, or the one country a remote role is limited to. Filled only on Remote roles and only with countries the listing names. Null means unstated, not worldwide.

workplace_city.description: City where the role is based. Null when the job names none, or lists alternative places and the title does not name one of them.

workplace_region.description: State, province or other region of the role's place; for alternative places, only when they all share it.

workplace_country.description: Country name of the role's place, including the one country a remote role is limited to; for alternative places, only when they all share it. Every country a remote candidate may live in is eligible_countries.

workplace_country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of workplace_country, or EU for the European Union.

job_source_name.description: Where Bordfeed found the listing, for example greenhouse. The `source_name` feed filter matches it.

department.description: Department or team as the source or the listing names it, free text. The `department` feed filter matches it exactly.

travel_required.description: True when the listing states it. Bordfeed does not infer false: false appears only when the source itself states it. Null means the listing does not state it.

career_level.description: Seniority of the role on the career ladder. Holds one value (the lowest when several apply); it is an array so filters can match several levels. Null when unstated.

visa_sponsorship.description: Yes when the listing says the employer sponsors work visas. No when it says it will not, including a requirement to work without sponsorship, to be authorized for any employer, or to be a citizen; a plain work-authorization line is not a refusal. Bordfeed sets a value only when a phrase in the listing supports it. Null when unstated.

languages.description: ISO 639-1 codes of the languages the candidate must use in the role. Preferred languages are left out, and the language the listing is written in (`language`) appears only when the listing requires it.

industry.description: The employer's industry, one value from the industry list that company profiles use. Bordfeed reads it from the listing; once the job is linked to a company, it is the company's industry (the value most of that employer's listings state), so all of one employer's jobs share one industry. Null when unclear.

quality_flags.description: Quality warnings for this job: `no_place`, `perm_recruitment_wording`, `no_posted_date`, `salary_without_currency`, `salary_without_unit`. `admission_unscored` marks a job published while the check that it is an English job listing was unavailable. Empty or null means no warnings. Jobs that fail stricter checks are never published, so those checks are not listed here.

summary.description: One plain-text paragraph of two or three sentences on what the role does and its must-have requirements, at most 500 characters, written by Bordfeed from the listing. It leaves out the title, company, pay, location and work mode, which have their own fields. Every figure in it appears in the listing. Null when the listing says too little or the summary failed that check.

tools.description: Named software and platforms the role uses day to day (for example Figma, Salesforce, Jira), as free text. Technologies and competencies such as Python or copywriting are in skills.

salary_note.description: Pay qualifiers the salary fields cannot hold, such as OTE, plus commission, or depends on experience.

schedule.description: The role's regular schedule as the listing states it: standard is stated weekday daytime hours, on_call is a per-diem or as-needed job. Null when unstated.

security_clearance.description: Government security clearance the listing names; none means the listing says no clearance is required, and a background check is not a clearance. Null when unstated.

relocation_assistance.description: True when the listing states it. Bordfeed does not infer false: false appears only when the source itself states it. Null means the listing does not state it.

equity_offered.description: True when the listing states it. Bordfeed does not infer false: false appears only when the source itself states it. Null means the listing does not state it. Bordfeed sets true only when a phrase in the listing supports it.

hiring_urgency.description: immediate when the listing says it is hiring urgently or wants an immediate start; evergreen when the posting is always open (a talent pool or future openings). Bordfeed sets a value only when a phrase in the listing supports it. Null when unstated.

locations.description: Location labels exactly as the listing gives them (for example Remote - US). The workplace_* fields hold the same place as structured values.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language the listing is written in. Languages the candidate needs are in languages.

enriched_at.description: When Bordfeed last finished reading the listing into these fields.

model.description: Internal processing metadata; safe to ignore.

revision.description: Internal processing metadata; safe to ignore.

fields_from_source.description: Names of the fields whose values the source states directly, identity fields included. These values, an explicit null included, take precedence over what Bordfeed reads from the listing text.

monitor_status.description: Result of Bordfeed's latest check that the listing is still open (for example live, suspected_expired or expired). Null when not checked yet.

monitor_checked_at.description: When Bordfeed last checked that the listing is still open.

salary_normalized_at.description: Date of the reference exchange rate used for the annual USD salary fields. It is the rate's date, not when the conversion ran.

enrichment.description: Processing details for the job. Every published job has them.

relevance_score.description: How well the job matches the search, from 0 to 1. Present only when a search filter is active.

highlights.description: Title and description with search terms wrapped in <mark> tags. Present only when you request `include=highlights` and a search filter is active.

similarity_score.description: How similar the job is to the requested job, from 0 to 1 (higher is more similar). Present only on /jobs/{id}/similar responses.

html_snippet.description: Ready-made HTML preview of the job. Present only when you request `?include=html_snippet` on /feeds/{id}/jobs.

description_html.description: Job description as HTML. Present only when you request `?include=description_html`.

Job.description: A job listing with its employer, lifecycle dates and structured fields Bordfeed reads from the listing.

id.description: Company id. Null until the employer is linked to a company profile, usually within the hour; the name is present as soon as the job appears.

JobCompanyEmbed.description: Employer of a job listing: the linked company profile, or only the employer name the listing gives until the job is linked.

HealthResponse.description: Public service status. This endpoint needs no API key and runs only lightweight checks.

enabled.description: Turns scheduled webhook delivery on or off. A disabled feed still answers authenticated poll and export requests.

Feed.description: A saved feed: its filters, delivery settings and curation lists. The webhook `secret` is never returned; you set it on creation and cannot read it back.

errors.description: List of validation issues. Present only on 422 validation_error responses.

retry_after.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Present only on 429 and 503 responses.

balance_jobs.description: Prepaid jobs left on your balance. Present only on 402 insufficient_credits responses for pay-as-you-go plans.

price_per_job_usd.description: Price per unique job in USD. Present only on 402 insufficient_credits responses for pay-as-you-go plans.

topup_url.description: Link that opens Stripe Checkout for a pay as you go top-up of this workspace. It needs no Bordfeed sign-in and works for about an hour. Present only on 402 insufficient_credits responses for pay-as-you-go plans.

auth_md_url.description: Where an AI agent can read how to get access. Present only on 401 unauthorized responses.

docs_url.description: Link to the documentation for this error code

request_id.description: Unique id of this request. Include it when you contact support.

ErrorResponse.description: Error response shape shared by all endpoints. `error.errors` appears only on validation errors (422). `error.retry_after` appears only on rate limited (429) and service unavailable (503) responses. `error.auth_md_url` appears only on unauthorized (401) responses.

enabled.description: Turns scheduled webhook delivery on or off. A disabled feed still answers authenticated poll and export requests.

FeedWithStats.description: A feed with delivery statistics. `last_delivery_at` is on the feed itself; `stats` holds the total number of deliveries sent.

Pagination.description: Pagination details. Feeds sorted by date return `next_cursor`; feeds with a search filter, sorted by relevance, return `next_offset`.

CompanyBrief.description: Company summary returned by list endpoints.

TrendingCompanyBrief.description: Company summary plus hiring velocity. Returned by GET /companies/trending.

HiringVelocity.description: Active job counts over 7, 30, and 90 day windows.

ats_connections.description: ATS boards explicitly linked to this company (Greenhouse, Lever, Workable, etc.). Present on GET /companies/{id}, but commonly an empty array: many ATS boards are operated by a group on behalf of several employers, so they are not attributable to a single company. Do not treat an empty array as evidence that a company has no ATS presence.

AtsConnection.description: A job board on an applicant tracking system (ATS) that Bordfeed reads for this company.

FeedTemplate.description: Ready-made set of feed filters you can start a feed from.

JobFeedback.description: A job quality report Bordfeed accepted. Bordfeed reviews every report.

SearchSuggestResponse.description: Job title suggestions that resemble the query.

apiKey.name: Authorization
apiKey.description: Your API key, sent as a Bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer bf_live_...`. Create keys in the dashboard under API Keys.
